title: Co(acac)2-catalyzed allylic and benzylic oxidation by tert-butyl hydroperoxide
authors: Han, Xiaoqiang; Zhou, Ziyuan; Wan, Chuan; Xiao, Yumei; Qin, Zhaohai
reference: Co(acac)2-catalyzed allylic and benzylic oxidation by tert-butyl hydroperoxide | Han, Xiaoqiang; Zhou, Ziyuan; Wan, Chuan; Xiao, Yumei; Qin, Zhaohai | Synthesis (2013), 45(5), 615-620
experimental_procedure: General/Typical Procedure: Allylic and Benzylic Oxidation Mediated by Co(acac)2/tert-Butyl Hydroperoxide; General Procedure. To a soln of substrate 1 or 3 (10 mmol) and Co(acac)2 (257mg, 1 mmol) in acetone (20 mL), TBHP (5.14 g, 4.0 mmol, 4 equiv, 70%) was added dropwise and the mixture was stirred for at r.t. for 15 h. To the mixture was added aq brine and the soln was extracted Et2O (3 ×). The combined extracts were dried (anhyd MgSO4) and filtered, and the filtrate condensed under reduced pressure to give a crude product that was purified by column chromatography. Substrate: 3i, 3-Nitrobenzaldehyde (4i), Light yellow solid; yield: 1.00 g (66%). Temperature: 28°C. 1H NMR (300 MHz, CDCl3, 25 °C): δ = 10.14 (s, 1 H), 8.73-8.72 (m, 1 H), 8.52-8.48 (m, 1 H), 8.26-8.23 (m, 1 H), 7.81-7.76 (t, 1 H).

title: Direct benzylic oxidation with sodium hypochlorite using a new efficient catalytic system: TEMPO/Co(OAc)2
authors: Jin, Can; Zhang, Li; Su, Weike
reference: Direct benzylic oxidation with sodium hypochlorite using a new efficient catalytic system: TEMPO/Co(OAc)2 | Jin, Can; Zhang, Li; Su, Weike | Synlett (2011), (10), 1435-1438
experimental_procedure: General/Typical Procedure: Gram scale preparation of 2a. To a solution of 1a (8.4 g, 50 mmol) in CH2Cl2 (150 mL) at 0-5 °C, TEMPO (0.39 g, 2.5 mmol) and Co(OAc)2 (0.12 g, 0.5 mmol ) were added followed by the quick addition of a sample containing 150 mmol of aqueous sodium hypochlorite at pH 8.3. The mixture was vigorously stirred for 6 h. The organic phase is separated and washed with water. The solvent was evaporated off. Purification of the residue by recrystallization. Benzaldehyde (2i) 7. Colorless oil. Selectivity: 94%, Yield 89%. 1H NMR (400 MHz, CDCl3): δ = 10.00 (s, 1H), 7.83-7.90 (m, 2H), 7.62 (t, J= 7.4 Hz, 1H), 7.52 (t, J= 7.5 Hz, 2H). 13C NMR (100 MHz, CDCl3): δ =191.9, 136.1, 134.2, 129.4, 128.7. MS (EI): m/z (%) =106 (M+, 33), 105 (100), 77(58), 51 (19).
